title: the top floor is a hospital
content: I just happened upon a tiktok thread describing a dream i had days ago. i got immediate chills. i remembered feeling so refreshed when i woke up. it was so vivid. i was in this huge hotel? it was like a hundred or more stories tall. the upper floors were kind of like a spa different people and creatures relaxing coming in and out the vibes were so pleasant. in the middle was a glass circular elevator and along the outside of the room was a spiral staircase going down around the elevator if you can picture that. i can try to draw it. the thing that totally freaked me out and gave me CHILLS was seeing other people say the top floor is a hospital. no joke every morning i tell my partner about my dreams because they're so vivid and i specifically told them the top floor was a hospital, i just woke them up to tell them about this i am completely shocked right now
